note: Phrases that must never appear in anything the kit generates or prints as a status, result or label, because they could be read as an external outcome (an examination passed, a certificate held, readiness for audit) when the kit has only checked internal state. Matched case-insensitively. Single words are matched as whole words. Used by audit/tests/test_status_wording.py. Prose in documents is checked separately. The prose check (scripts/check_claims.py) also uses prose_only_phrases and reads every text file in the repository; places that must mention a phrase are listed with a reason in scripts/claims_allowlist.json.
